text:
Maya Rao: Quick check — planning to start a staged rollout for structured output / function-calling today. Plan below, want quick 👍/nits.

Maya Rao: TL;DR: enable server compat flag + SDK opt-in. Canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% over ~48h, with auto-fallback to 'text-only' model and circuit-breaker at error rate > 3%.

Josh K.: can you paste the exact flag keys and the SDK behavior? I want to add a QA test for mobile.

Maya Rao: flag keys: `feature.func_calling.structured_output.v1` (server) and `sdk.client.behavior.funccall_mode` (client). Client has three modes: `strict` (throw on unknown schema), `best_effort` (attempt to map), `disabled`. Default for rollout is `best_effort` for 1% canary; mobile SDK will ship `disabled` by default and we flip via remote config.

Rachel T.: guardrails: suggest 250ms soft timeout for extra parsing steps, and if parse fails fall back to raw text in response field + analytics event. Also add a regression eval set run after 25% rollout.

Alden (eng-sre): Can we get an autoscale trigger tied to canary qps? If 1% spikes unexpectedly we want capacity to handle parsing overhead. I can wire a temporary policy.

Maya Rao: Yes — Alden, please enable a burst policy: +2 pods for canary audiences. I'll add a short-lived HPA rule.

Linda - devex: For the SDK release notes I'll include a snippet for how to toggle:```js
// client-side opt-in
client.updateConfig({
  funccall_mode: 'best_effort'
});
```
Also adding example of handling fallback: check `response.structured` else use `response.text`.

Josh K.: tests: adding these checks to smoke: 1) roundtrip idempotence for function signature, 2) unknown-field tolerance, 3) timeout fallback hits analytics. Will create PR and ping.

Maya Rao: rollout steps (proposed):
1) 09:00 — flip server compat flag for internal-only orgs + run smoke suite (1%)
2) +2h — increase to 5% if errors < 1% and latency delta < 15%
3) +24h — 25% and run regression eval set
4) +48h — 100% and flip SDK default to `best_effort` in next minor release

Maya Rao: emergency rollback: server flag -> off, SDK remote-config to `disabled`, and promote fallback model `llama-lowlatency` for all canaries. If error_rate > 3% OR regression score drops > 2 points, rollback immediately.

Rachel T.: one more ask — add a metric `func_call_parse_failures` to SLO dashboard and a corresponding alert at 0.5% for canary audiences.

Alden (eng-sre): created temporary alert rule `canary.funccall.fail_pct > 0.5% for 5m` and a playbook entry in runbooks (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/funccall-canary).

deploy-bot: deployment: toggles applied to env=prod-canary-1 by maya (1802507201) — server flag set -> `enabled` for orgs: internal-only, dev-team-a.

Maya Rao: I pushed the canary change and started the smoke suite — results look clean so far. Josh, Rachel, please watch the regression job and shared dashboard.

Josh K.: watching. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pull/412 (smoke tests + mobile config).

Rachel T.: regression job queued. I'll post results in this thread.

Maya Rao: thanks all — will bump to 5% in 2h if no red flags. Please @mention me if you see anything odd. :thumbsup:

Rachel T.: regression job done: no regressions detected, small latency +9% p95 for structured paths. Marking OK to proceed.

Maya Rao: bumping to 5% now. deploy-bot: toggles applied to prod-canary-5 by maya (1802507548).

Alden (eng-sre): autoscale exercised +1 pod, no OOMs.

Josh K.: mobile smoke passed on internal devices. No crashes.

Maya Rao: all good — next checkpoint: 25% tomorrow 09:00. I'll create an ops calendar invite.

Rachel T.: noted. Adding a post-rollout eval checklist to the PR.

Linda - devex: adding docs + migration note for customers: "Clients should handle missing structured payloads gracefully — prefer best_effort mapping."

Maya Rao: closing loop. If anyone wants to opt into earlier, ping me and I'll add your org to the canary list.

Josh K.: thanks, team.

Rachel T.: :rocket:
